usage: tr learn [-h] [--session SESSION] [--arm {champion,challenger}]
                [--status | --decide CHANGE_ID]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --session SESSION     playbook as of this session, YYYY-MM-DD (default: last
                        completed)
  --arm {champion,challenger}
                        playbook arm (default: champion)
  --status              rule changes, pairs so far, decision rule, MDE
  --decide CHANGE_ID    apply the §8.3 rule; writes only a final decision
